_about: Data for the Chai tray (js/cook/stations/chai-tray.js). `station`: its name, goal and one goal line per phase. `words`: ph-half/ph-full are now drafted centrally in data/cook.json (Zafar, 25 Sept, phonetic, unconfirmed: adh / bharelo), so nothing is merged from here any more; left empty as a hook if a station-only word is ever needed. `mechanic.levels`: the tray's own settings (who and what the order asks for is in the chai recipe's slots, by level, Wave 6: 1 = one cup; 2 = two; 3 = three; 4 = three plus half/full, when the half line is drawn too). lines: where the dashed lines sit in a cup (the same on every cup, so they never answer the order); tolerance: how close to a line counts as on it; halfLine: unused since Wave 6b (both lines are always drawn, and a tap on the pan pours to the next one: half, then full); extras: the bowls for elchi/ginger and their look-alike (on the tray from level 1, asked for or not); decoys: the look-alikes beside the sugar; boilLevel: the back burner's boil level (its tray profile is in mechanics.boil).

station.name: Chai tray
station.goal: Each person says how they like their chai. Give each cup what its person asked for, and turn the burner down before it boils over!

phases.water: Tap the jug: water into the pan, up to the dashed line.
phases.tea: Add the tea to the pan.
phases.knob: Tap the big knob to light the burner.
phases.cups: Tap a cup. Give it what that person asked for.
phases.pour: Tap a cup, then tap the pan to pour: once to the first line, again to the top. Then the tick.
